Curated Social gives real estate professionals ready-to-post graphics, captions and automated posting [1]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on social posts and work in different ways.

Curated Social is a social media marketing platform designed for real estate professionals, part of Steps Marketing, a real estate marketing firm established in 2006 [3]. It offers thousands of ready-to-post graphics and captions, branding bars, an AI caption writer and automated posting with Autopilot, and says over 100,000 agents and brokers use it [1].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social posts and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.

Curated Social offers a vault of thousands of ready-to-post real estate graphics and captions, with new content released every Sunday [1][2]. Its AI Rewrite reworks a caption to the tone, length and pronouns you choose [1].
VEXI makes graphics in your brand.
Curated Social’s branding bars add your photo, logo and contact information to any post, made in its built-in editor or with the Canva button, on the Plus and Pro memberships [1][2].

Curated Social connects to channels such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X (Twitter) [1].
